result.summary: The page appears to be a well-designed food delivery app interface with no critical issues. However, there are a few minor visual and layout concerns, particularly with the truncated content at the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The pizza image at the bottom is cut off by the navigation bar, making it appear incomplete and potentially confusing.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient padding at the bottom of the scrollable content area so that the last item is fully visible above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name is truncated, which might make it harder for users to identify the restaurant.
issues.suggestion: Consider using a smaller font size, abbreviating differently, or allowing horizontal scrolling for restaurant names to show full text.

issues.description: The '-0%' badge on the pizza image seems unusual and might be confusing to users as it doesn't convey a clear discount.
issues.suggestion: Review the logic for displaying discount badges. If there's no actual discount, consider hiding the badge or showing a different promotion message.
